details: A pending comparison save cannot be submitted twice
A delayed comparison save retains both exact captured cases, bridges and axes
The later visible target edit remains in the workbench
The comparison status identifies the earlier save and unsaved current edits
The earlier saved comparison link opens the actual returned entry
The changed comparison can be saved after the prior operation completes
A pending scenario save cannot be submitted twice
A delayed scenario save retains all exact captured inputs and bridge balances
A bridge-only edit remains visible after the prior snapshot saves
A bridge-only edit receives an honest earlier-save status
The earlier scenario link opens the actual returned entry
The edited bridge can be saved after the prior operation completes
Copying an unchanged comparison while saving retains the exact snapshot
Copying an unchanged calculation does not falsely mark it as unsaved
An unchanged calculation receives the normal current-save confirmation
Pending-save journeys produce no uncaught browser errors
verificationScope: Local Chromium release-candidate check; assertion counts are not counts of distinct users or browsers.
